import urllib.request, urllib.error
candidates = [
  'https://www.brandeis.edu/marder/PDFs/2004/PrinzNN2004.pdf',
  'https://www.brandeis.edu/marder/PDFs/PrinzNN2004.pdf',
  'http://people.brandeis.edu/~marder/PDFs/2004/PrinzNN2004.pdf',
  'https://link.springer.com/content/pdf/10.1038/nn1352.pdf',
  'https://www.nature.com/articles/nn1352.pdf',
]
for u in candidates:
    try:
        req = urllib.request.Request(u, method='HEAD', headers={'User-Agent':'Mozilla/5.0 neuron-channels (mailto:a.nikolaev@sheffield.ac.uk)'})
        with urllib.request.urlopen(req, timeout=20) as r:
            print(u, '=>', r.status, r.headers.get('Content-Type'), r.headers.get('Content-Length'))
    except urllib.error.HTTPError as e:
        print(u, '=>', 'HTTP', e.code, e.reason)
    except Exception as e:
        print(u, '=>', 'ERR', type(e).__name__, str(e)[:80])
